item.title: Fine weather to continue, dust expected from Wednesday
item.description: A weak high-pressure system is affecting the region, while a strengthened north-easterly air current is expected to influence the area from Tuesday, according to the weather forecast. item.description: A 27-year-old man reported to police that his motorbike was stolen while parked outside the apartment building where he lives in Paphos. item.title: Macron and Mitsotakis to visit Cyprus in show of support
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron and Greek Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis are visiting Cyprus in a move seen as signalling support for the Republic amid heightened tensions in the region. item.title: Cyprus launches national campaign to cut water use by 10%
item.description: Cyprus has launched a nationwide campaign to reduce water consumption as dam levels drop to about 21% of capacity amid prolonged dry conditions. The initiative, titled “Water for tomorrow”, is being led by the Ministry of Agriculture in cooperation with the Ministry of Education and the Water Development Department (WDD). item.title: 38 flights cancelled at Larnaca airport on Monday over Middle East tensions
item.description: A total of 38 flights were cancelled on Monday at Larnaca airport due to the situation in the Middle East. According to airport data, 19 arrivals and 19 departures operated by various airlines were cancelled. item.title: Airline shares battered as oil prices spike, Iran war intensifies
item.description: Surging oil prices and the escalating U.S.-Israeli war with Iran hammered airline stocks in Asia on Monday, piling pressure on carriers already navigating tight airspace as travellers scramble to evade the Middle East conflict. item.title: Four arrested in Cyprus police night operations
item.description: Cyprus police arrested four people during overnight operations carried out across the island as part of efforts to prevent serious crime and maintain public order. Police said the arrests were linked to offences including theft by an employee, motorcycle theft and public insult. During the operations, officers stopped and checked 809 drivers and passengers overnight. […]

item.description: The Group of Seven (G7) finance ministers will discuss on Monday a joint release of oil from emergency reserves coordinated by the International Energy Agency, the Financial Times reported. item.title: Bahrain’s Bapco announces force majeure on operations
item.description: Bapco Energies declared force majeure on its group operations on Monday following a recent attack on its refinery complex, the company said. Bapco said that all domestic market needs remain fully secured and supplies will continue without disruption, supported by proactive plans in place. (Reuters)
